Education and age requirements of the applicants:(1) Those pursuing bachelor degree must have a high school diploma and be under 25 years old;(2) Those pursuing master degree must have a bachelor's degree and be under 35 years old;(3) Those pursuing PhD degree must have a master's degree and be under 40 years old;(4) Non-degree program students should be under 45 years old.3. Non-other scholarship recipients.4.
